name: Famine
summary: IPC alert warns drought and war are pushing Darfur and Kordofan towards famine; no new Phase 5 found
state: An IPC alert on 13 Oct warned that drought and war are pushing parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan in Sudan towards famine (AllAfrica; Sudan Tribune). Drone strikes on power stations are adding to the strain (AP). El Niño drought also threatens southern Africa. Searches on 7 Nov found no new IPC Phase 5 classification.
for_you: Readers can support UN and Red Cross appeals; there is no direct risk to most readers.

sources.title: AllAfrica — IPC Sudan food insecurity and malnutrition alert
Sudan Tribune — IPC alert on Darfur and Kordofan

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
